note: Andbank's book of tariffs (22 January 2026): its Visa Open card costs 52 euros a year to issue and hold, and deferred payments carry 1.80% a month (24.24% TAE). Its commission of 1% on the credit limit granted, at most 90 euros a half-year, isn't written, the game holding no card limit.
